question: Who is the world's youngest international chess grandmaster as of 31st December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sergey Karjakin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sergey Karjakin** is recognized as the world's youngest international chess grandmaster as of 31st December 2020.
 
• He achieved the grandmaster title at the age of **12 years and 7 months**, a record that still stands.
 
• Sergey Karjak
